study.title: UAV-based intelligent weed detection using YOLO11 and PSPNet for precision agriculture
study.short_title: YOLO11-PSPNet weed detection+region segmentation in rice paddy

segmentation.domain: weed detection (YOLO11-s bounding boxes) + region-specific semantic segmentation (PSPNet on bbox crops) in rice paddy UAV imagery, targeting site-specific spraying; dataset annotated at tillering stage
models_tested: YOLO11-PSPNet (proposed): YOLO11-s detector (C3K2 blocks, SPPF, C2PSA spatial attention) + PSPNet segmenter (ResNet-50 backbone, 4-level pyramid pooling 1x1/2x2/3x3/6x6), RAdam+SAM optimizer; model trained sequentially
segmentation.best_model: YOLO11-PSPNet: mAP50 0.9956, precision 0.994, recall 0.982, mIoU 0.9827, IoU 0.9961, DSC 0.832, inference 6.2 ms/img (hardware unspecified)

dataset.name: Rice paddy weed dataset, Therakalputhoor, Kanyakumari District, India (Roboflow)
dataset.note: Captured July-Aug 2024 with Autel Robotics EVO II Pro (CMOS 20 MP, 80% forward / 80% side overlap, vertical view) over 150 m x 85 m (12,750 m2) field at tillering stage; flight altitude 5-25 m. Split 70/20/10 train/test/val; images resized to 640x640; histogram equalization + augmentation; Roboflow bbox annotation.

segmentation.backbone: PSPNet with pretrained ResNet-50 backbone + dilated convs; Pyramid Pooling Module (adaptive average pooling, 1x1 convs, bilinear upsampling, concat fusion); YOLO11-s detector for bbox generation

mIoU.quote: The proposed YOLO11-PSPNet model attained a precision of 99.4 % and a recall of 98.2 %. The model accurately detected weeds in the paddy field, with an mAP50 of 99.56 %, an IoU of 99.61 %, and a DSC score of 83.2 % ... IoU (%)  99.61   mIoU (%)  98.27   DSC (%) 83.2
mIoU.section: Results / Performance analysis of the proposed model
mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU 98.27% reported in Table 2 alongside IoU 99.61% and DSC 83.2%; values appear inflated and some tables report mAP50 (99.56%) for both detection and segmentation; exact class scheme for IoU not stated.

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; precision 0.994/recall 0.982 imply F1 ~0.988 (derived, not reported).

Dice.quote: ...an IoU of 99.61 %, and a DSC score of 83.2 %.
Dice.section: Results / Performance analysis of the proposed model
Dice.ambiguity: DSC 83.2% (Table 2); noticeably lower than the reported IoU 99.61%/mIoU 98.27%, suggesting inconsistent metric computation; treat with caution.

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1 reported (rice paddy only as background crop).

edge.framework: Training: SGD (pspnet) / RAdam+SAM (YOLO11-PSPNet), lr 0.001, batch 16, momentum 0.937, weight decay 0.0005, 50 epochs; inference hardware NOT specified

fps.ambiguity: FPS not directly reported; 6.2 ms/img implies ~161 FPS (derived).

latency_ms.quote: The proposed model achieved an inference time of 6.2 ms per image, demonstrating that the proposed YOLO11-PSPNet framework outperforms existing approaches.
latency_ms.ambiguity: Inference time 6.2 ms/image for the combined detection+segmentation pipeline; hardware on which it was measured is NOT reported. Authors claim 'suitable for deployment on edge devices' and 'real-time deployment' potential but perform no on-device benchmark.

issues: Reporting inconsistencies: mAP50 99.56% claimed for both detection and segmentation; IoU 99.61% vs mIoU 98.27% vs DSC 83.2% suggest unreliable metric computation.
Inference hardware (CPU/GPU) not specified; 6.2 ms/img real-time and edge-deployment suitability claimed without on-device measurements.
Segmentation is region-specific on YOLO11 bbox crops; exact number of classes / weed-vs-crop masking scheme unclear.
Comparisons (Table 4/5/6) cite external results rather than re-trained baselines.
GSD reported as 0.225 cm/pixel (0.00225 m/px); flight altitude range 5-25 m.
